speaker: Marchwarden Edda
description: P29 (plan M6-M9 §5.7, §5.9, decision 26): Brannock's oath (quest.oath_march). Meeting her sets oath.march.met. Help: once the toll fort's gate is breached and its garrison broken and the Raiders' Hollow is clear, the report swears the oath (950 XP once: Brannock allied, its banner and the free reinforcement's iron). Intimidate (stage 4, 750 XP once): Brannock swears and pays 2 iron of tribute. Force: with the south gatehouse smashed she swears out of fear (700 XP once). Hostile, she will only take 2 iron for the harm done (outcome reconcile_brannock: FactionState reconciles the town, every time it is paid).

nodes.text: A giant at Brannock... I am Edda, marchwarden of this town. The toll-riders bleed the King's Road from their fort east of the bridge, and raiders out of the Hollow prey on the road from Kingsgate. Brannock owes its oath to whoever keeps the March - and no one keeps it.

choices.text: I will free the March's roads for you.
[Loom over the hall] Brannock will swear its oath to me. Now.
choices.locked_text: Return when you stand at stage 4

nodes.text: Then break the toll-riders' fort - its gate and its garrison - and clear the raiders out of the Hollow west of the road. Come back to me when the March's roads are free, and Brannock will swear.
The March's roads are not free yet: the toll fort still stands, or the Hollow's raiders still ride.

choices.text: [Loom over the hall] Enough waiting. Brannock swears to me now.
choices.locked_text: Return when you stand at stage 4

nodes.text: The toll fort broken and the Hollow empty - the March's roads are free for the first time in years. Brannock keeps its word.
...Brannock will swear. Take our tribute - and leave our walls standing.
You broke our gate... The town will not fight something like you. Brannock swears its oath to you, giant - out of fear.
Get out of my town, giant! Brannock's bells ring for you.

choices.text: Pay for the harm you did. (2 iron)

nodes.text: ...Brannock forgives the harm, if not the fright. Our smith will work for you again.
The March is yours, friend. Our smith will work your iron, and Brannock's banner will open doors in Aldmere.
You have your tribute. What more do you want of us?
Brannock keeps the oath it swore in fear. Go.
